bio: Hull tech. Patches things before they fail, including people.
Wears the ship’s old boarding plate. Steps in front of everything and lets it hit her.
Welder. Throws plating over whoever is nearest when she swings.
Was cargo crew. Absorbs punishment and keeps walking.
Xeno-chemist. Aerosolises samples and lets the wind do the rest.
Reactor tech. Everything she touches keeps burning after she leaves.
Demolitions. Waits for the pile to get big enough, then lights it.
Field biologist. Corruption jumps hosts when one dies; she counts on it.
Helm. Reads the flow of a fight and shoves people into it early.
Too fast, too eager. Fires whenever anyone else does.
Survey drone pilot. Sweeps the whole line looking for cracks.
Ship’s gunner. One target. One number.
Ex-salvage. Enormous, patient, hits like falling cargo.
Waits for something to crack, then puts everything into the gap.
Xeno-botanist. Tags every specimen before she touches it.
Sensor officer. Paints the whole line at once, lightly.
Cryo-analyst. Freezes a shell until it fractures on its own.
Ship archivist. Answers every hit on anything Quill has written down.
Ship medic. Treats the crew like equipment: patched before it fails.
Navigator. Calm, unhurried, hits back without seeming to notice.
Reactor engineer. Gives away her own power and runs cold doing it.
